config.style_lock: Hand-drawn storybook RPG character concept art: large head (about 4 heads tall), small slender body, sturdy shoes, large gentle eyes, whimsical fairy-tale charm matching the character's age. Illustrated painting with dark ink and sketchy pencil contour lines, hatching, chunky brushed shading in a few clear tones, mottled colored-pencil shading, visible paper grain, rich warm jewel-toned colors, warm golden light from upper-left. Not clean digital art, no smooth airbrushed 3D shading. Flat #808080 mid-grey studio background.
